context: This repo has no versioned migration framework (Flyway/Liquibase/EF migrations) — schema/tables/*.sql is a single monolithic DDL set, not incremental migrations. 'Migration complexity' here is scored as effort-to-modernize (per README.md's own stated purpose: 'designed for modernization analysis and migration workshops'), not migration-script chronology.
overall_rationale: Business logic is split three ways with no clean boundary (Forms client triggers, PL/SQL packages, DB triggers) — README self-documents this as known technical debt. Several cross-file defects (broken EMPLOYEE_HISTORY insert, seed/DDL drift, audit check-constraint mismatch) mean the current codebase does not even run cleanly as-is, which must be resolved before any migration, not during it.

reasons: EMPLOYEES is the central table with 4+ FKs, a self-referencing manager hierarchy, BLOB/CLOB columns (PHOTO_BLOB, NOTES), and encrypted PII (SSN_ENCRYPTED) whose decryption logic lives in an unread PL/SQL package body — migrating this table means re-implementing PKG_SECURITY.decrypt_ssn's algorithm faithfully or re-encrypting all data
TRG_EMP_BEFORE_UPDATE's broken EMPLOYEE_HISTORY insert must be fixed/understood before the audit trail can be trusted as a migration source

VW_ORG_HIERARCHY has a self-documented performance warning ('degrades significantly with >500 employees') via CONNECT BY — a modernized platform needs a different hierarchy strategy (closure table, recursive CTE, or materialized path)

Federal/state tax brackets, FICA rates, and Medicare thresholds are ALL hard-coded as 2024 calendar-year values in PKG_PAYROLL.pkb (TAX_BRACKETS table exists but is never read). Any modernization must either port these constants or implement table-driven bracket lookup — the TODO comment confirms the latter is the stated intent.
HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD filing status produces $0 federal tax withholding — a payroll compliance defect that must be assessed and may require retroactive payroll correction before migration.
Pretax deductions (401k, HSA, medical) are NOT subtracted before bracket calculation ('simplified' per code comment) — taxes are overcalculated for employees with pretax elections.
PAYROLL_RUNS.TOTAL_NET and TOTAL_DEDUCTIONS exclude BENEFIT element type — header-level summary totals are wrong for most employees. Payslip detail is correct.
calculate_payroll commits every 50 employees — on failure, the run is in a partially-committed state. No clean retry path exists.
get_payslip returns YTD_GROSS=0 and YTD_NET=0 (hardcoded placeholder) despite a working get_ytd_earnings function.
Circular package dependency PKG_EMPLOYEE ↔ PKG_PAYROLL complicates any incremental/strangler-fig migration.
VW_PAYROLL_LATEST's single-global-latest-run assumption is a design bug requiring a product decision before porting.
Bank account encryption mechanism for ACCOUNT_NUMBER_ENC is unconfirmed (no matching PKG_SECURITY function found).

AVAILABLE balance formula is divergent in THREE places — virtual column and get_leave_balance (correct: 5-term with -PENDING); VW_LEAVE_SUMMARY and process_carryover (4-term, no -PENDING). Product owner must designate the canonical formula before migration; carryover amounts may already be inflated.
run_monthly_accrual only processes ACCRUAL_FREQUENCY='MONTHLY' — any leave type with a different frequency is permanently excluded. This is an undocumented functional gap.
expire_carryover has a self-documented double-subtract bug if run twice on the same day — no idempotency guard.
Employees with NULL manager get leave requests stuck permanently in PENDING (no approver in queue) — must be resolved before migration.
LEAVE_ACCRUAL_LOG.RUN_ID is never populated by the batch procedure — column contains only NULLs.

Accrual and carryover batch jobs confirmed as DBMS_SCHEDULER (monthly and as-needed), but the scheduler job CREATE scripts are not in the source repo — they must be located in DBA maintenance scripts.
Straightforward parent-child structure (REVIEW_CYCLES → PERFORMANCE_REVIEWS → PERFORMANCE_GOALS)
Heavy CLOB usage (SELF_ASSESSMENT, MANAGER_ASSESSMENT, STRENGTHS, etc.) — free-text fields port cleanly to any modern text/JSON column
UI/DB mismatch on GOAL_CATEGORY poplist (Forms only offers 3 of 5 valid values) needs a product decision, not just a technical port

PKG_SECURITY's MD5 password hashing and hard-coded DBMS_CRYPTO key are security defects that should be fixed during migration, not carried forward — but doing so requires a password-reset/re-encryption migration step for all existing users, which is itself operationally complex
AUDIT_LOG's ACTION_TYPE check-constraint mismatch with the STATUS_CHANGE audit call must be resolved (constraint or caller) before the audit trail is trustworthy

No ROLE/PERMISSION table exists in the schema — access control appears to be hard-coded inside PKG_SECURITY.has_permission's body (unscanned), which is a migration blind spot: the actual authorization rules are not visible in any table, DDL, or Forms XML scanned so far

pre-migration_blockers: Fix or explain the EMPLOYEE_HISTORY column/constraint mismatch — TRG_EMP_BEFORE_UPDATE uses wrong column names; PKG_EMPLOYEE.log_history is the correct implementation and should replace/fix the trigger
Fix or explain the seed-vs-DDL column mismatches (LOCATIONS.PHONE, JOB_GRADES.GRADE_LEVEL/GRADE_CODE, SYSTEM_PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION)
Resolve the AUDIT_LOG.ACTION_TYPE vs. 'STATUS_CHANGE' compliance gap — leave status changes produce no audit record (silently swallowed, not a crash)
PKG_SECURITY.authenticate has no password verification — confirm whether this is intentional (demo system) or a production security defect before any migration proceeds
Fix SQL injection vulnerability in PKG_EMPLOYEE.search_employees (dynamic SQL string concatenation, self-documented) before any production migration
Assess HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD payroll compliance gap — employees with this filing status have $0 federal tax withheld
Resolve AVAILABLE balance formula fork (3 divergent implementations: virtual column/get_leave_balance vs VW_LEAVE_SUMMARY vs process_carryover) — carryover amounts may be currently inflated
Read PKG_REPORTING.pkb — only remaining unscanned package body
Fix VW_EMPLOYEE_COMPENSATION salary date-scope predicate — view can return duplicate rows and incorrect COMPA_RATIO for employees with overlapping active salary records (RC-009)
Resolve USER_CREDENTIALS table status — referenced in PKG_SECURITY but absent from all DDL files; confirm existence and obtain DDL before migration security assessment is complete (A-022/G1-Q9)
